label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: label atlas: newly drawn names convert and upload only their rows (labelAtlasRows) from a persistent pixel buffer with a revision log; small updates bypass the frame-time gate, so names update during gestures (previously the whole 4-16 MB atlas was copied and converted per change and new names waited until the map had been still for 250 ms)

line groups carry a 64-bit content id; the renderer keeps groups by id and the packet carries bodies only for groups it does not hold (unchanged tiles referenced, not re-sent, re-parsed or re-hashed); a missing reference falls back to a full send
prepared topographic vector tiles kept in an LRU cache after leaving the view (24 tiles at <=3.2 GB RAM, 40 at <=4.2 GB, 64 above; 8 on low-RAM devices)
routes re-drape only when the terrain under them changes (fingerprint of the intersecting cover); only intersecting patches are sent to the worker and draped per segment

tests.gpu: overlay_drape with group references (Vulkan and GLES); route_smoke with terrain-elsewhere and terrain-under-route checks (fails on 0.1.26); label_occlusion, waypoint_occlusion, topo_filter, overlay_pool, overlay_parity pass on Vulkan and GLES
